prompt_scheme: r = sha256(prompt_record())[:6] — the prompt as converse() actually renders it, over six probes, three of which carry an offer in the history, plus MAX_LISTED and MOST_AT_ONCE. Superseded q (the same over three probes, none carrying an offer, so a prompt change conditioned on an offered history line was invisible to it) on 2026-09-13, and p = sha256(converse.py)[:6] on 2026-09-10. A p-, q- and r-named file are NOT comparable by fingerprint; compare converse_file_print, or diff prompt_record between a q and an r.
